title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.10.9
body_markdown:
*released November 12th, 2024*

### What's New in this Release

### Developer Community

* [Fatal error C1001: Internal compiler error](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Fatal-error-C1001:-Internal-compiler-err/10708308)
* [MSVC 14.40.33807 generates incorrect assembly with std::coroutine and truncates a pointer](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/MSVC-144033807-generates-incorrect-ass/10745358)
* [Incorrect codegen at /O2 in MSVC toolset v19.38 and up](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Incorrect-codegen-at-O2-in-MSVC-toolset/10764869)
* [C++ Modules and LINK : fatal error LNK1000: Internal error during IncrBuildImage.Pass2](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/C-Modules-and-LINK-:-fatal-error-LNK10/10255969)

### Security advisories addressed

* [**CVE-2024-43498**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-43498).NET NrbfDecoder component Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
* [**CVE-2024-43499**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-43499).NET NrbfDecoder component Denial of Service Vulnerability
* [**CVE-2024-49044**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-49044) Visual Studio Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
